dimensions.note: Comparative ethics sections 4 and 7: Tuan finds the brain-as-body/person distinction difficult and later avows her own decision in the confrontation with Miach. These are local tensions and represented commitments. Neither an integrated motivational hierarchy nor a stable general response policy follows from them; the analyst's defense of agency is not automatically Tuan's complete psychology.

The essay locates separate deliberative and final-confrontation moments, but a model of changes in Tuan's knowledge, commitments and dispositions between them has not been established. Mere narrative order does not supply a developmental transition rule.

The essay paraphrases first-person avowal and interprets its formal role. A source-language Tuan register, lexical repertoire, recipient-conditioned speech policy or acoustic voice has not been established from this evidence set.

The curated essay concerns political ethics and a final confrontation; a Tuan-specific account of ordinary routines or mundane responses has not been established. A description of the surrounding health society is not evidence of her every ordinary action.

Tuan's confrontation with Miach and response to Nuaza are identified, but a conditional account of how distinct relationships change her responses has not been established. The personally specific object of the final violence does not itself establish a relationship model.

Section 4 attributes difficulty defending a person/body boundary to Tuan; section 7 interprets her first-person avowal. This supports bounded questions about represented uncertainty and asserted agency. Avowal does not establish freedom from prior influence, all private motives, or the truth of every self-description.

Section 7, linked HAR-U019: Tuan avows a decision and directs final violence toward Miach. The essay distinguishes its personally specific object and bodily immediacy from Clavis's population-scale intervention. This constrains interpretation of that confrontation, not the frequency, escalation or resolution of other conflicts.

Sections 4 and 7 distinguish Tuan's difficulty with the treatment/personhood boundary, her asserted conscious choice, and the absence of moral vindication for revenge. These local deliberative tensions are supported; the comparative essay's broader normative argument is not a demonstrated Tuan decision procedure for unfamiliar ethical choices.
No Tuan-specific humor or play repertoire has been established from the curated comparative essay. This gap does not demonstrate an absence of humor in the character.

The complete active_provisional comparative essay was reviewed as repository analysis. Its Tuan discussion is bounded chiefly to the HAR-U014 treatment/personhood exchange and HAR-U019 final avowal, not a complete character corpus, original-witness rereading, separate monograph, model or HAR-U020 epilogue assessment.

Sections 4 and 7 provide affirmative countercases to flattening Tuan into a fully settled defender of autonomy whose conscious choices are necessarily benign: the treatment/personhood distinction troubles her, and her final asserted choice includes personally directed violence. These are local constraints, not proof that every future choice is violent or that agency is absent.

Section 4 identifies the HAR-U014 exchange and section 7 the HAR-U019 confrontation. They remain distinct disclosed moments, with the assessment ending at the latter. Later epilogue facts, an exact calendar time and a continuous intervening knowledge state are not established by this bounded assessment.

scenario_readiness.note: No generation or evaluation of new Tuan dialogue has been established. English analytical paraphrase of first-person avowal is not demonstrated Japanese dialogue competence.

No counterfactual or materially unfamiliar scenario has been assessed with fixed chronology, interlocutor relationship and setting constraints. No cross-scenario transfer or globally reusable Tuan model is asserted.
No readiness assessment for an ordinary new social encounter has been established from these political and climactic passages; ordinary functioning is not denied.
The essay supports interpretation of bounded canonical ethical tensions. No new ethical-choice scenario, conditional response procedure or independent predictive test has been established.

No romantic or relationship-scenario readiness assessment has been established. The personally specific confrontation with Miach does not determine behavior in another relationship or romantic setting.
No professional-response scenario or occupational behavior model has been established from this curated essay. Project-wide model labels and roles described elsewhere are not inherited.

known_limits.statement: Section 7 distinguishes Tuan's avowal of a conscious act from moral justification of revenge. Her actually violent choice prevents an unqualified inference that asserted agency always entails benign or consent-respecting action.

Section 4 attributes difficulty defending the brain-as-body/person distinction to Tuan. A rigid, fully settled rule rejecting every treatment of psychological suffering would erase that represented difficulty.

Section 7 expressly distinguishes Tuan's personally specific violence from Clavis's nationwide act. Formal first-person parallels cannot transfer his motives, technology, knowledge or scale of action to her.

This assessment establishes no complete weighting of Tuan's private motives, freedom from earlier influence, continuous knowledge trajectory, exact calendar placement or later epilogue state. Missing support is not evidence that a motive or capacity is absent.

Only the subject's directly curated comparative essay qualifies here. Her separate monograph, models, validation trials and original Japanese source have not been independently assessed in this run. Ordinary behavior, source-language voice, relationship transfer, humor and novel-scenario readiness remain unestablished within this evidence boundary, irrespective of broader material elsewhere.

dimensions.note: The monograph states a governing value hierarchy (duty, proportionality, truth, coalition responsibility, respect for persons, internal constraint), a central belief that the manner of victory determines what survives, and five failure modes. It expressly disclaims that the game wrote one fixed personality and extracts the most coherent military-professional through-line from a player-directed choice space. This supports interpretation of what the archetype values and refuses; it gives no conditional, scene-located behavioral rules.

Three game-level phases are characterized (military diplomat, ethical contaminant within Cerberus, coalition commander), each as a thematic stance. No within-game ordering, mission sequence or state-transition rule is given.

No game dialogue is quoted or analyzed. The monograph's block-quoted lines are the analyst's paraphrases, introduced as what the archetype says in effect, not attested speech. Nothing about Shepard's register is established, which says nothing about the games' actual dialogue.
The monograph contains no ordinary, off-duty or low-stakes behavior; nothing is established.

Relations are given by category: squadmates as persons rather than assets, species and historical enemies as potential co-belligerents, Cerberus and the Illusive Man as ideological temptation, the Council and Alliance as slow institutions. No individual squadmate, romance or crew relationship is named, so only category-level canon questions are supported.

Stated beliefs and fears (fear of becoming what is fought, moral injury under impossible standards, discomfort with every ending) are attributed to the archetype by the analyst. They support bounded questions about the archetype's professed stance; they are not depicted interior states of a specific Shepard.

A force doctrine is stated: protective, proportional, directed, restrained where restraint does not abandon the innocent, with distinctions between coerced and willing enemies, combatants and civilians, factions and species, and an explicit willingness to threaten, deceive and kill when required. Named outcomes (destroying the Collector Base, addressing the genophage, brokering quarian-geth peace) are asserted without scene evidence, so this is a doctrine rather than located conflict behavior.

The monograph's core is an ethical doctrine with a worked deliberation over the four endings, each weighed with reasons, and a Cerberus stance distinguishing use of its resources from adoption of its worldview. It identifies the considerations the archetype weighs and refuses. The deliberation is the analyst's reconstruction of a coherent archetype, unlocated in game text, and its judgment that Paragon most likely chooses Destroy reluctantly is a prediction, not an observation.
Nothing on humor or play is established.

The monograph declares itself a corpus-governing interpretive model and not an exhaustive transcript audit, cites no missions, dialogue lines, codex entries or recordings, and names no edition or playthrough. Trilogy-wide breadth without source location.

Affirmative limits are stated: Paragon is not nice Shepard, not pacifism, legal formalism or every blue dialogue option; five failure modes including naive trust, procedural sentimentalism and game-rewarded idealism; and no ending is fully compatible with the ethic. These counter a flattening benevolent reading, but as interpretive assertions rather than located contradictions.
Only the three-game phase structure and the ending choice are placed in time; no default state is fixed when a period is unspecified, and no mission or date chronology is supplied.

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph contains no attested dialogue and its quotations are analyst paraphrases. Dialogue generated from its principles would be fluent invention, not source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not the games.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The trilogy-wide corpus archetype at any of its three coarse phases; no mission-level moment or playthrough state is fixed.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Any counterpart, since the monograph names no individual relationship; the refusal holds for allies, enemies and institutions alike.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts outside the trilogy's command situations
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than analyst-level value comparison

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph is designed for comparative analytical use beside other characters and supports value-level comparison by an analyst. It supplies no behavior, speech or decision procedure for simulating Shepard in a crossover or counterfactual and disclaims a fixed personality, so cross-scenario simulation is not supported by this evidence set. The scope below names the only context in which even this refusal was assessed.
No ordinary social content; nothing is established.

conditions: The dilemma is a command-context ethical or political choice of the kind the monograph treats: use of force, coalition trust, truth versus manipulation, civilians, enemy categories, emergency authority.

Output is a value-level account of which considerations the archetype weighs and what it refuses, stated as tendency rather than certainty, with the monograph's failure modes available as counterweights.
No specific game mission mechanics, dialogue lines, squadmate names or playthrough facts are asserted as canon.
The subject is the corpus archetype, not any particular player's Shepard.
scenario_readiness.note: The monograph's ending-problem section models this kind of reasoning. Readiness is conditional because the doctrine is interpretive and unlocated in game text.
No romance or intimate-relationship content; nothing is established.

conditions: Military-professional command or political-military context framed by the Alliance, N7 and Spectre foundation the monograph describes.

Prediction is limited to command posture and priorities (discretion used to protect persons and legitimacy, coalition over domination, refusal to let necessity cancel personhood), not to tactics, procedure or speech.
No specific mission, squad composition or in-game outcome is asserted.
The archetype's stated failure modes remain possible outcomes.
scenario_readiness.note: The monograph's subject is professional military authority under weakened external constraint, so posture-level professional prediction is supported; operational detail is not.

known_limits.statement: Section 0 and the corpus-use rule state that the game provides a player-directed choice space and that no single psychologically seamless Paragon personality is claimed; every claim here concerns the corpus archetype, not a canonical individual.

The corpus-use rule states that Paragon Shepard is not synonymous with maximum kindness, pacifism, legal formalism or choosing every blue dialogue option, and may threaten, deceive, kill and exercise broad emergency authority.
The front matter and section 0 declare the monograph a corpus-governing interpretive model and not an exhaustive transcript audit; named decisions and outcomes are asserted without scene evidence.

Section 13 records that the trilogy sometimes rewards Paragon choices with unrealistically optimal outcomes, and section 11 that no ending is fully compatible with Paragon ethics; predictions of clean outcomes are unsupported.

No attested dialogue, register, individual squadmate or romance relationship, mundane behavior, mission chronology, edition or playthrough variable (origin, class, gender, survivors) is part of this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence that the games lack them.

dimensions.note: The model states a governing thesis (the strength-and-premium-ingredients equation broken by the V02 defeat without exposing her craft as fraudulent), five gated developmental states with operative policies, stable commitments, and a ten-row conditional decision policy labeled H/M/U with volume-image locators. This is a bounded operational interpretation usable for school-era culinary and club situations. It is one active_provisional secondary artifact whose warrants cannot be rechecked within this evidence set, its validation is the author's own nonblind self-audit, and it marks the childhood memory's broader causal weight as interpretation. No unconstrained simulation support follows.

Five states are gated with transitions and binding limits: recalled family formation (02-168 to 02-169), early Erina-aligned enforcer (02-104 to 02-111), fairly defeated new member (02-166 to 02-175), voluntary collaborator and autonomous cook (V05, V07 and the V08 cutoff), society defender and peer recognition (V20, V21). The endpoint rule forbids presenting the school default as the V36 adult state. The states are coarse, Ikumi-specific states between V08 and V15 and after V21 are not described, and the adult endpoint is expressly unestablished.

Seven attested Japanese forms are recorded from original images with context and limit: あたし; あんた and hostile テメェ; えりな様; mocking 主将さん; surname address 幸平; the hesitant 食べるか？, contracted 食わねぇ and emphatic だからな sequence; and the objection to 肉魅. They support bounded canon questions about address and register in the V02 and V06 scenes. The model states they do not license a complete dialect grammar or an audiovisual performance model, the forms come from two volumes and 22 inspected images, and the discovery row does not enroll SPEECH for this subject.

Observed ordinary texture is limited to the V06 summer bonus (club cooking before Soma arrives, heat complaints, sharp familiar talk with Konishi, a hesitant food offering, conditional acceptance of shaved ice, one strawberry-milk choice; 06-186 to 06-189) plus mainline voluntary community and festival labor (V05, V15, V16). The model labels the bonus low-weight supplementary evidence and extends it only at M to an unfamiliar school kitchen. A domestic routine, nonculinary hobbies, an adult managerial style and the response to a small unrelated loss are expressly unestablished.

A six-row recipient-modifier table (Soma; Konishi and the Donburi Research Society; Erina; community collaborators; independent opponents or judges; unfamiliar juniors, customers or adults) gives per-recipient boundaries, and a matched-recipient rule holds a dish-adjustment request constant across Soma, V21 Erina and an unfamiliar peer. The variation is evidence-based for Soma, Erina and the society; unfamiliar recipients are restricted to task-only inference at M. The evidence is Soma-weighted, the Erina relation rests on two states (V02 patronage and withdrawal, V21 recognition), and the model forbids inferring reciprocity from embarrassment.

Emotion-to-action routing is described for pride, embarrassment, hurt, fair-loss destabilization and affection, each tied to located scenes (V02 anger and honored wager, V06 hurt and qualified acceptance, V21 recognition of Erina's burden). Interior states are inferred from depicted behavior; the model treats Soma-directed romantic coding as an interpretation of bounded evidence and warns against making the childhood memory an automatic flashback. Substantial inference without a demonstrated interior model.

Conflict rules cover escalating formal stakes as early enforcer (02-104 to 02-111), registering a fair defeat while remaining in the field (02-166 to 02-175), accepting contextual correction after the duel (V05), and competing through her own cooking when Central threatens the society (V20, 3-0). A typed failure table and negative controls separate technical, social and institutional consequences and reject expanding the comic knife threat into literal violence. Ordinary conflict outside familiar school work, a later adverse-result response and leadership accountability are declared material gaps.

Established locally: early overreach (demolition planning and demanding Soma's expulsion as a stake) is treated as consequential rather than banter, and V20 reverses the direction of her intervention. The model states this does not prove reflection on earlier harm or an invariably fair leadership style, and marks the junior-complaint probe U. No deliberation procedure for an unfamiliar ethical choice is supplied, and the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The model records mockery (主将さん), a comic knife threat and the summer-bonus comic, but treats them as low-weight or as patterns to restrain; no Ikumi humor or play repertoire is established. This gap says nothing about the character's actual humor.

The model draws on the project's completed original-Japanese V01-V36 corpus and verifies 22 images from V02 and V06 against recorded source locks, while stating that no whole-volume, character-arc or full-series primary reread of Ikumi was performed and listing material gaps (later adverse response, full V20 dish and opponent chain, sustained leadership, adult life). Ikumi-specific retrieval is targeted (V02, V05-V08, V15-V16, V20-V21); her V22-V36 appearances are not itemized.

Affirmative canonical limitations are located: the V02 whole-bowl defeat despite real meat skill, the V05 criterion correction, the V07 score of 86 excluded by V08's 91 cutoff, the V06 declined offering, weak V15 stall sales inside a coalition, and the V20 win bounded to local survival. An explicit negative-control list rejects fake-expertise, price-absolutism, romantic-reciprocation, literal-violence and Soma-credit readings. Each case is documented inside one secondary artifact and not independently validated.

The model fixes a default state when time is unspecified, forbids silently backdating endpoint knowledge, locates every rule by volume and archive image, and keeps the serialized ending and the three Le dessert tiers distinct. In-world dates and school years are not fixed and no state after V21 is specified; the rule selects a period, it does not give fine chronology.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states its attested forms do not license a complete dialect grammar or an audiovisual performance model, and supplies new-scene behavior as M-level descriptions that are expressly not quoted dialogue. Lines generated beyond the seven attested forms would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Ikumi's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is fixed to the model's default latest detailed school state after the V20 win and the V21 disclosure, or to one earlier gated state named explicitly; no adult or post-V21 state is used.
The situation is a concrete culinary, club or shared-service problem in a school or community kitchen where the model's H and M rules apply.

The interlocutor is Soma, Erina in her V21 state, Konishi or the Donburi Research Society, a named community collaborator, or an unfamiliar peer handled in task-only mode without invented relationship history.

The model's negative controls forbid inferring reciprocity, a couple, consent or desire from blushing, service or tasting spectacle, and list reciprocal romance as an abstention surface. The evidence establishes asymmetric Soma-directed interest as an interpretation and nothing further.

conditions: Only school-era culinary work: club cooking, collaborative product development (V05), the independent curry brief (V07), festival stall labor (V15, V16) and society defense (V20).

known_limits.statement: The model's endpoint rule states that present analytical coverage does not establish a sufficiently detailed adult Ikumi state and forbids inventing an adult job, private routine, romantic outcome or family-business succession; the school default must not be presented as the V36 endpoint.

The model lists later adverse-result response, the full V20 dish and opponent chain, ordinary conflict outside familiar school work, and sustained leadership accountability as material gaps; the V20 3-0 win is bounded to local survival.

Blushing, volunteering, service and tasting spectacle establish neither reciprocity, a couple, consent nor private habit; asymmetric Soma-directed interest is the model's interpretation of bounded evidence.
The early comic knife threat is not a prediction of literal violence in an unfamiliar scene, and 肉魅 is an attested object of her protest, not a welcome form of address.

The model describes its own validation as a nonblind reconstruction self-audit distinct from the project's original terminal audit, carries readiness substantial, provisional without promotion, and is active_provisional. No independent or held-out validation is part of this evidence set.

The model's linked deep readings D02-D21, the state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, the evidence matrix and the fidelity audit are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here.
